name: Harem Days
source:
Main character is an ordinary student who often skips classes in favor of club activities and part-time jobs. One day his childhood friend Haruka barges in and decides to live at protagonist's house. Then Haruka's elder sister Chiaki comes to persuade Haruka to return home, but stays to live together to protect her sister from man's advances. Is this the beginning of a harem?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名普通学生，经常为了社团活动和兼职而逃课。一天，青梅竹马遥突然闯进他家，决定与他同住。随后，遥的姐姐千秋前来劝妹妹回家，却为了保护她不受男人骚扰，也留了下来一起生活。难道这就是后宫生活的开端？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
